articles.title: Cỗ máy tỷ USD tìm cách 'mở khóa' năng lượng nhiệt hạch
articles.summary: Pacific Fusion is constructing a billion-dollar machine aiming to unlock commercial fusion energy within four years. The company seeks to overcome historical scientific challenges to produce clean, abundant power. This milestone represents a major step forward in the transition toward sustainable energy sources.

articles.title: 5 công nghệ pin xe điện có thể thay thế pin lithium-ion
articles.summary: Researchers are developing five innovative battery technologies designed to replace traditional lithium-ion cells. These emerging alternatives aim to improve energy density, safety, and charging speeds for next-generation electric vehicles. Adopting these technologies will also help manufacturers reduce reliance on scarce mineral resources.

articles.title: Robot hình người lộ nhiều điểm yếu tại Thế vận hội
articles.summary: Humanoid robots demonstrated impressive athletic capabilities during recent competitive events by breaking several human benchmarks. However, the machines struggled significantly with complex tasks requiring high precision and adaptability. These results highlight key technological gaps that engineers must solve to deploy robots in real-world scenarios.

articles.title: Săn và giữ chân nhân tài công nghệ tại Trung Quốc
articles.summary: Chinese artificial intelligence and semiconductor firms are aggressively competing to recruit and retain key technical talent. Companies are offering competitive salaries, equity incentives, and improved career pathways to attract top specialists. This talent acquisition strategy aims to strengthen domestic self-reliance in advanced technological development.

articles.title: Nhịp cầu vòm bê tông dài nhất thế giới
articles.summary: The Tian'e Longtan Bridge over the Hongshui River sets a new world record with its 600-meter main concrete arch span. Innovative engineering techniques allowed builders to reduce the required concrete volume by twenty-two percent. The project marks a significant breakthrough in large-scale structural efficiency and civil engineering.

articles.title: Sun PhuQuoc Airways mở đường bay thẳng Phú Quốc - Kuala Lumpur
articles.summary: Sun PhuQuoc Airways has launched a direct air route connecting the resort island of Phu Quoc with Kuala Lumpur. The airline operates daily round-trip flights to accommodate growing tourism and commercial demand. This expansion is expected to boost international travel and regional integration between Vietnam and Malaysia.

articles.title: Các điểm ngắm pháo hoa ngày 2/9 tại TP HCM
articles.summary: Ho Chi Minh City is hosting Independence Day fireworks across seven distinct vantage points on September 2nd. Spectators can enjoy public viewing areas or reserve scenic riverside restaurants around the Saigon River to avoid heavy crowds. The planned celebration offers local residents and travelers diverse ways to experience the festivities.

articles.title: Các điểm ngắm pháo hoa ngày Quốc khánh 2/9 ở Hà Nội
articles.summary: Hanoi has planned spectacular fireworks displays across four major city locations to celebrate National Day on September 2nd. Visitors can view the displays starting at 9:00 PM from multiple well-situated spots around the capital. The initiative aims to provide memorable cultural experiences for residents and domestic travelers during the holiday.

articles.title: NexCOBOT discusses physical AI market hurdles and acceleration
articles.summary: NexCOBOT is addressing key industrial challenges in motion control and safety to accelerate the commercialization of physical AI. The company highlights how partnerships with major tech giants are driving growth across diverse automation sectors. These advancements enable manufacturers to deploy safer and more adaptable robotic systems in complex industrial environments.

articles.title: Skild AI unveils S1 flagship robot foundation model
articles.summary: Skild AI has introduced its flagship S1 robot foundation model to enhance general-purpose machine autonomy. The model enables robots to learn and execute new physical tasks simply by observing demonstration videos. This capability significantly streamlines the training process for automated industrial and service operations.

articles.title: From spreadsheets to AI: Deere gives farmers new features in Operations Center, JD
articles.summary: John Deere has rolled out JD, an artificial intelligence tool integrated into its Operations Center for modern agriculture. The platform analyzes historical farm data to provide actionable management insights for growers. Farmers can leverage these automated recommendations to improve crop yields and maximize operational profitability.

articles.title: HowToRobot and Robotics Australia Group partner on platform to encourage robot adoption
articles.summary: HowToRobot and Robotics Australia Group have partnered to create a unified platform promoting automation adoption across Australian industries. The initiative helps businesses assess automation opportunities, test solutions, and connect directly with local equipment vendors. This collaborative ecosystem aims to accelerate digital transformation for small and medium enterprises.

articles.title: Fervo Energy and Google ink largest-ever geothermal PPA to power data centers
articles.summary: Fervo Energy and Google have signed a landmark 396-megawatt power purchase agreement for geothermal energy in Utah. The agreement represents the largest corporate geothermal power deal to date and will support clean energy delivery for data centers. The project is scheduled to begin commercial operations by 2028 to deliver steady baseload electricity.

articles.title: The US built more grid batteries last quarter than ever before
articles.summary: The United States set a new record for grid battery storage installations during the last quarter as renewable capacity expanded. Plunging costs for lithium-ion battery cells have made utility-scale energy storage more financially attractive for grid operators. These battery systems play a critical role in storing excess green energy and maintaining power grid stability.

articles.title: Alzheimer’s may leave a mark on the brain long before plaques appear
articles.summary: Researchers discovered that Alzheimer's disease begins altering brain patterns at least seven years before amyloid plaques become detectable on standard PET scans. The findings stem from a long-term study that tracked healthy older adults through brain imaging over nearly two decades. This insight opens up promising opportunities to detect the disease and intervene much earlier in its progression.
